# openwrt_network_bridge_vlan (Resource)

Manages a bridge VLAN assignment in OpenWrt.

~> **Destroy ordering**: When `openwrt_network_bridge_vlan` and `openwrt_network_device` reference the same bridge (e.g., `br-guest`), add `depends_on = [openwrt_network_device.br_guest]` to the bridge_vlan resource so Terraform destroys the VLAN config before the bridge device. If the device is destroyed first, the network service reload may remove the bridge-vlan UCI section automatically, which the provider now handles gracefully.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Bridge device name (e.g., 'br-lan').
- `ports` (Map of String) Ports for this VLAN (e.g., {eth0 = 'u*', eth1 = 't'}).
- `vlan` (Number) VLAN ID (1-4094).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: network/<device>_<vlan>.
- `section` (String) Internal UCI section identifier (e.g. 'cfg0abc12') of the anonymous section backing this resource. Managed automatically; resolved on import.
